NSCameraUsageDescription: Simo uses the camera for video calls, live streams, profile photos and identity verification selfies.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Simo uses the microphone for voice and video calls and live streams.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Simo needs access to your photos so you can choose a profile photo and share photos and videos.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Simo uses your location to show people near you. Your exact location is never shown to others.
